source_ref: Australian Customs Tariff: general customs duty of 5 percent on most goods, applied to consignments above AUD 1,000 (Australian Border Force)
note: 5 percent is the general rate for most goods; some goods carry other rates. Taken from the product decision and commercial guides, not read from the Customs Tariff schedule: a broker should confirm. Alcohol and tobacco are not priced.

source_ref: Goods with a customs value of AUD 1,000 or less: no customs duty and no GST at the border; GST is charged at sale by registered sellers (Australian Border Force; ATO, GST on low value imported goods)
note: Threshold read as at or below AUD 1,000. Broker to confirm.

source_ref: Goods and services tax of 10 percent on imported goods (ATO; Australian Border Force)
note: GST base (goods plus shipping plus duty) is a working reading: broker to confirm.
